datePolicy: Source access dates are retained from the original November 5, 2026 register. This offline article adaptation did not revisit external sources; editing dates are not source refresh dates. Publication, effective and historical benchmark dates remain distinct from access dates.
uncertainties: Ohio paid leave: inspected official inventory vintage September 2023 has no Ohio row; November 2026 enactment status was not exhaustively verified. State wage replacement is modeled at zero, not determined ineligible. Employer/public-employee benefits are separate.

Actual pay, paid leave/PTO/disability overlap, FMLA eligibility, same-employer spouse limits, premiums, networks, individual/family caps, birth/return dates and available childcare places are unknown.

All future uplifts, quantities, wages, employer overhead, reserves, setup, premiums, gear tax/shipping and billing timing are estimates. Listing stock and checkout prices are not guaranteed; no safety clearance or medical feeding/developmental advice is given.
KFF benchmark uses 2021–2023 employer claims published September 9, 2025, not a Columbus or 2027 quote; pre-May prenatal bills and exceptional care beyond chosen reserve excluded.

Child Tax Credit 2026 maximum is a labeled fallback; official 2027 indexed amount not located in original inspected material. FSA limits are beginning-2026 planning assumptions; 2027/2028 eligibility/elections and household tax treatment require checking. Default cash benefits zero.

Workbook cached values were inspected read-only; no recalculation performed for this article. Original source prose rounds consumable totals differently by one cent; model-derived totals use unrounded unit costs.
editingContract: English-only local draft adapted from finished-run materials. No Chinese file, new Review/stars, publication, website integration or shared package edits. No unhosted local artifacts linked in the reader body.
